issue: Entry does not persist after page reload
actual: After creating a new entry "Test Task" and reloading the page, the entry disappeared. The entry count returned to 5 entries, and only the original entries remain.
evidence: Before reload: 6 entries including "Test Task"; After reload: 5 entries without "Test Task"

Successfully added four new fields: Notes (Text), Effort (Number), Start Date (Date), and Urgent (Checkbox). All fields are visible in the field configuration list and appear as new column headers in the table view with "—" placeholder for empty values.

Successfully created an entry with text (Notes: "Test note content"), number (Effort: "8"), dates (Start Date: "Sep 5, 2026", Due Date: "Sep 15, 2026"), and checkbox (Urgent: checked). All values are correctly displayed in both table view and card view.

Successfully switched from table view to card view and back. All 6 entries remained present with identical field values in both views. The entry "Complete quarterly review" with all values (Priority: 2, Due Date: Sep 15, 2026, Notes: Test note content, Effort: 8, Start Date: Sep 5, 2026, Urgent: Yes) was displayed correctly in both views.

Successfully applied Priority sort (ascending) to table view, then switched to card view which showed unsorted entries. Applied Due Date sort (ascending) to card view. Switched back to table view and verified it still had Priority sort intact. Both views maintain independent sort selections.

Successfully used quick search to filter entries. Searched for "Team" which showed only 1 matching entry ("Team sync meeting notes") out of 6 total entries. Entry count updated to "1 entry matching 'Team'". Cleared the search and all 6 entries were restored with no data loss or modification.

issue: Manual reordering via drag-and-drop is not functioning
actual: Drag handles are visible and footer shows "Drag entries to reorder" message, but attempting to drag entries to different positions results in items being dropped in their original positions with status message indicating the item was dropped over itself.

issue: Import feature not found in accessible UI
actual: No visible Import button or menu option found in the application interface. Fields dialog mentions "Configure fields before importing data" but no import control is visible or accessible.

evidence: Attempted to type non-numeric text "abc" into the Priority number field. The field rejected the input with error "Cannot type text into input[type=number]", demonstrating proper HTML5 number validation that prevents non-numeric values.

Quick search successfully filtered entries by text "Team" (case-insensitive), displayed "1 entry matching 'Team'", and restored all 6 entries when cleared. Text matching and filtering works correctly.

issue: Quick search does not match formatted displayed values
actual: Searched for "Jan" which appears in formatted dates (e.g., "Jan 15, 2026") but search returned 0 results. This indicates the search matches internal raw values, not the formatted dates shown to users.

evidence: Sorted table by Priority (ascending) - all 6 entries remained with identical values. Entry count stayed at 6 and no data values were lost or modified during sorting.
Filtered by searching "Team" - showed exactly 1 matching entry out of 6 total. Cleared the filter - all 6 entries restored with no data loss or modification.

Verified all entries and field values display consistently in both table and card views. Empty values shown as "—" in both views. "Complete quarterly review" entry with all values (Priority: 2, Due Date: Sep 15, 2026, Notes: Test note content, Effort: 8, Start Date: Sep 5, 2026, Urgent: Yes) displayed identically in both views.

Field configuration dialog shows clearly labeled field types: Text, Number, Date, and Checkbox. Entry form provides appropriate controls: textbox for text fields, spinbutton for numbers, date input for dates, and checkbox for boolean fields.

Checkbox states clearly distinguishable: "Urgent" field entry with checkbox set to checked displays as "Yes" in card view and checked checkbox image in table view. Unchecked checkboxes display as "No" or unchecked checkbox image.

Selected Priority sort field - table immediately reordered entries by priority (1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3). Active field identified by "Priority" button label and sort indicator icon. App remained fully usable with all controls functional.
Attempted to type "invalid" into the Start Date date field. The field rejected the input with error "Malformed value", demonstrating proper HTML5 date validation that prevents non-date values.
